description: Fetch the top 5 recent news articles about a specific topic using a public no-auth API.
nl_goal: I want to catch up on the latest aerospace news. Please fetch the top 5 recent news articles about 'SpaceX' from the public Spaceflight News API and print the JSON result.

paradigm_3_config.skill_description: A standard tool to retrieve the latest spaceflight and aerospace news articles by topic.
